summary: The cyclic profile bound follows correctly from the full central triangle, convexity, the two singleton-area lower bounds, and the resulting rectangle bound for each doubleton cell. The explicit triangle has the stated coordinate areas and inverse Jacobian, so it realizes the entire P-table exactly. Independent rational checks confirm the repaired row totals, cap sums, crossings, tails, W=0, all four residual tests, both completion filters, all nine radical capacities, and every opposite inequality. The candidate also correctly restricts its geometric realization claim to the P-table and leaves the Q- and midpoint-table realizability tests open.
